definitions.explanation: The ability to respond cleverly and appropriately in the moment, especially in conversation.

examples.japanese: {機知|きち}に{富|と}んだ{返答|へんとう}だ。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{機知|きち}に{富|と}んだ{人|ひと}だ。
{司会者|しかいしゃ}の{機知|きち}に{富|と}んだトークで{会場|かいじょう}が{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The venue was livened up by the host's witty talk.

notes:
A somewhat literary or formal word for wit and quick thinking. Almost always appears in the set phrase {機知|きち}に{富|と}む (to be rich in wit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機知|きち}に{富|と}む — to be witty, to be full of wit
- {機知|きち}に{富|と}んだ — witty (as modifier)
- {機知|きち}に{富|と}んだ{会話|かいわ} — witty conversation
- {機知|きち}に{富|と}んだスピーチ — a witty speech

USAGE:
This word is rarely used outside the set phrase {機知|きち}に{富|と}む/{富|と}んだ. It is more common in written language, book reviews, and formal descriptions of people.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ユーモア — humor (loanword, broader)
- ウィット — wit (loanword, same meaning)
- {頓知|とんち} — clever response, quick thinking (often associated with riddles and folk tales)
